integrationInstruction: Apply mechanism corrections to discovery records and every selected/alternate embedded copy by id. Keep the current selected 25; no substitute needed. Do not change author research intervals or assign audit time as research.
identityReview: 100 distinct screened recipient identities, not 100 completed IRS/processor crosswalks. Known EINs unique. Programs/brands such as NAM Clinic, Omega House, Grace Place, former AIDS Foundation Houston, former Center for Pursuit, HVL/HBF and coalition partners are appropriately distinguished. Exact tax identity and fund restrictions remain alpha prerequisites where incomplete.
selectionReview: All ten cohorts cover all 100 once and compare selected candidates against reserves using health pathway, whole-recipient costs, substitution and harms. Twenty-five are defensible research priorities, not measured best-value charities. Clinical-access nine, addiction one, mental-health one, violence three, repair three, nutrition two, environment two, legal two and disability two. Excluding general housing from the selected set is an explicit health-only research tradeoff, not a zero-value conclusion. No ranking or membership change is compelled by this focused audit.

routeReview.qualification: Discovery eligibility relies on real named recipient and relevant activity, not verified payment settlement for all 100. Preserve explicit unresolved statuses; do not advertise 100 fully verified donation checkouts. All selected recipients have named organizational support routes, but payment processor settlement and donor marginality remain untested.

staleOrScopeFindings: Three replacement mechanism labels are materially wrong and must be fixed; underlying identities and cohort comparisons remain valid.

Santa Maria Jacquelyn campus closure/bed relocation is already distinguished from total organization closure; current nonprofit and giving continue. Avenue360 temporary Spring Cypress closure similarly does not negate other current clinics.

Common Threads local source is partly historical and current site signals SNAP-Ed loss/digital training transition. Retain as reserve with current physical Houston capacity unresolved, not confirmed unchanged school delivery. Healthy Futures likewise has historical local evidence plus current statewide policy scope.

HHRA exclusion should remain an unresolved payee/current-status lead, not a claim of nonexistence: current Allies in Hope primary page independently corroborates collaborative outreach. This new corroboration does not require replacing Bee Busy or adding a 101st active discovery.

Saved retrieval ordinals 1,74,80 originally refer to excluded predecessors. Match sources by URL and named identity, not ordinal alone; corrected replacement primary sources were independently reopened.

Wider statewide/national providers, Bayou watershed and out-of-MSA Walker/Grimes/Washington/Beaumont effects are not assumed fully local. Discovery county lists are minimum intersections, not health attribution fractions.
